title: Rav Tachlifa bar Imi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot 4:4: “Huna bar Chinena and Rav Tachlifa bar Imi were sitting before Rabbi Elazar.” Rabbi Yonah said: “If all of them are bar Imi, this one is bar Rav Imi; if all of them are bar Rav Imi…” Penei Moshe explains that Rabbi Yonah was in doubt whether, wherever Rav Tachlifa bar Imi is mentioned, the Rav Tachlifa who sat before Rabbi Elazar is the son of Rav Imi, or whether we must read “Rav Tachlifa bar Rav Imi” everywhere.

notes.text: The Aramaic exchange is compressed and is translated literally; Penei Moshe’s explanation follows.

The complete scene and Penei Moshe explanation were read at the consulted digital Maasrot 4:3, while Hyman supplies 4:4. His locator is retained. The two bar Imi/bar Rav Imi possibilities remain alternatives, and the supplied quotation breaks off before the continuation.
